languageData.SoftResinTendrilTile.label: soft resin tendril tile
languageData.SoftResinTendrilTile.description: Tiles made of soft resin, shaped into tendrils. They are alive, so they are quicker to build, and work to keep the surface clean on their own. The soft resin makes them particularly attractive. Note that walking over this tile in bare feet might tickle a bit.
languageData.HardResinTendrilTile.label: hard resin tendril tile
languageData.HardResinTendrilTile.description: Tiles made of hard resin, shaped into tendrils. They are alive, so they are quicker to build, and work to keep the surface clean on their own. The hard resin makes them quicker to construct but not as attractive. Note that walking over this tile in bare feet might tickle a bit.
